DSV4F MHC/sparse attn vs Gated DeltaNet

wins_screened.mechanism: After admit_session, payload_view returns the mmap window without SHA-256. Catalog file SHA is checked at open; a four-tensor sample is rehashed once. Token path does not walk 74k tensor digests.

measured.note: Facet 1 also switched bind from parse-to_vec+copy to mmap no-copy MTLBuffer. The 17.8 ms is SHA-skip plus the copy elimination, not SHA alone.

DSV4F.why: Admission-trust already sets hash_invocations=0 (3314 trust hits). The leftover tax is path_resolve+stat+remap of 3314 chunks, not SHA.

Qwen3.8.why: Dense. open() fs::reads every tensor once into persistent MTLBuffers. There is no per-token payload SHA and no expert first-touch.

wins_screened.mechanism: Independent same-input GEMVs share one serial encoder; the ten-expert wave is one fence with device SiLU + weighted sum. 493 waits become 337. GPU arithmetic is unchanged.

DSV4F.why: Already collapsed 137→134. The leftover CBs wait because host MHC must read wo_b bf16 before FFN, and learned-bias layers must read 6 route IDs before the slab bind. That is a host data edge, not a missing encoder merge.
DSV4F.already_applied: ordered encoder per CB; 6 expert act_quants fused to 1; hash route+moe share one CB

Qwen3.8.why: step() already encodes embed + 64 layers + terminal into one MTLCommandBuffer and waits once. wait ≈ gpu + 0.5 ms. There is no 493-CB tax to fold.

wins_screened.commit: 341825888 (bundled with I/O overlap); shipping dispatch is ACT_QUANT_SIMD_KERNEL
wins_screened.mechanism: One simdgroup owns one 128-col block, simd_max for amax, same UE8M0 rung and E4M3 RNE encoder as the 1-thread authority kernel.
wins_screened.g023: STRUCTURAL. Q80/Q38 consume f32 x. Act-quant is an extra bf16→e4m3+e8m0 pass DSV4F must do before every FP4/FP8 matvec.

Q80.why: There is no 128-col amax→e8m0→e4m3 stage. Inserting one would add bytes and a kernel. G023 forbade folding act-quant into Q80.

Qwen3.8.why: Q4 matvec reads f32 activations. Same missing stage as Q80.

wins_screened.mechanism: Scratch MTLBuffers allocated once at graph open. Expert payloads are 16 KiB-aligned mmap windows bound with new_buffer_from_verified_bytes; a silent copy is a hard error.

Q80.why: Facet 1 already pins mmap weight windows. Grouped GEMVs and the routed wave already reuse scratch/wave buffers. The leftover is MixedGpu::matvec still new_buffer_checked for input and output on the ungrouped path (down_proj, out_proj, singles).
Q80.expected_ns_note: Order-of-magnitude: tens of ungrouped creates per token × 10–100 µs Metal alloc. Not measured in isolation. After facet 2 most mixer traffic is grouped.

Qwen3.8.why: Qwen38HybridWorkspace and every Q4/f32 weight buffer are allocated once in open(). Decode does not create buffers.

wins_screened.mechanism: While the attention command buffer is on the GPU, the host mmaps shared-expert and (on hash layers) the six expert slabs. Learned-bias layers cannot do this: route IDs are not known until the route CB returns.
wins_screened.measured_bundle: simdgroup act_quant + overlap + no-copy: body 3286 ms → 1109 ms. Expert slab after route is still 406–437 ms GPU-idle.

Q80.why: Same shape as DSV4F learned-bias: host top-k must produce the 10 IDs before those payloads can be bound. You cannot hide bind under the mixer GEMVs. You can only pipeline bind with the routed-wave GEMVs, or submit the previous suffix without waiting (Q4 split-overlap; not a robust wall win).
Q80.expected_ns_note: Upper bound is leftover bind 45.8 ms. Realistic is a fraction: first-touch of new (layer,expert) pairs over a generate is ~10k unique, but IDs arrive after the router. Q4 HAWKING_QWEN80_OVERLAP_CBS=split was not robust (B1 −34 ms, B2 +80 ms).

Qwen3.8.why: All 755 catalog tensors are resident after open. There is no per-token weight I/O to hide.

wins_screened.mechanism: qwen80_gated_delta_decode_tg launches 1 threadgroup per value head and loops 128 independent value columns behind threadgroup barriers. qwen38_gated_delta_decode_vi launches 1 threadgroup per (head, vi). Same left-to-right key reduction, same association. Occupancy ×128.

Q80.why: Same S/δ/S/o recurrence (QWEN38_REUSE_MATRIX). heads/key_dim/value_dim are already buffers. Mixed-1p5 still runs source_qwen80_recurrent_deltanet on the host between two GPU CBs; the Q4 hybrid already dispatches qwen80_gated_delta_decode_tg with grid (kd, heads, 1). Port is: put mixed on that kernel, then set grid.z = value_dim. Do not rewrite the math.

DSV4F.why: No Gated DeltaNet. Attention is MHC + compressed-indexer sparse + learned-bias route. G023 STRUCTURAL.

deltanet_q80_estimate.question: Does Q38 vi-parallel transfer to Q80's 36 DeltaNet layers, and how many ns?
deltanet_q80_estimate.math: SAME_RECURRENCE. Q80 36×32×128×128 vs Q38 48×48×128×128. Metal already takes heads.

isolated_scaling.serial_occupancy: 1 TG/head. 32 TGs (Q80) and 48 TGs (Q38) both sit far below 60 GPU cores, so per-layer serial time is the 128-column barrier loop, not head count.
isolated_scaling.q80_serial_isolated_how: 11490666 × 36/48. Do not also scale by 32/48 heads.

q80_q4_hybrid.why: Q4 is host-sync bound (table-build). A 7 ms GPU cut inside a prefix CB that already waits on host top-k often does not land 1:1 on the token. Unmerged token −12.2 ms was on a 135 ms vehicle with a more exposed mixer CB.

q80_mixed_1p5.why: Host recurrence is on the critical path between two waited CBs, so every host nanosecond is wall. Moving it to vi-GPU removes that host slice and adds ~1.1–1.6 ms of GPU that can share the out_proj / mixer CB. Unmerged mixed-prefix cuts were 6–12 ms wall. Mixed-1p5 wall is 1171 ms; this is ~1% but it is real and cheap.
q80_mixed_1p5.prerequisite: Wire qwen80_gated_delta_decode_tg (or the Q38 vi kernel with heads=32) into qwen80_mixed_hybrid_decode::deltanet_mixer. Then set grid.z=128. Do not keep the host loop.

implementation_cost.scale: 1 = hours (flag + grid), 2 = a day (wire existing kernel, keep host as refuse-not-fallback), 3 = multi-day topology
